name: Stone to Sand
description: Any tool or mod that destroys stone drops a pile of sand. Does not replace other mods' dig profiles.
author: laser-stone-to-sand

enabled.label: Drop sand when stone is destroyed
enabled.description: Applies to the laser, drill, void gun, and any other mod that clears stone.

sandPerStone.label: Sand per stone cell
sandPerStone.description: How many sand grains each destroyed stone cell tries to leave behind.
